h1.protocol: Unit: products sold in exactly one country (avoids counting one product several times), known food group, top 10 countries. Outcome: all 8 core per-100 g nutrients present. Per food group with >=2 countries of >=200 products: chi-square test of independence country x complete, effect Cramer's V, Holm correction over food groups, alpha 0.05. H1 supported if a majority of tested groups is Holm-significant with V >= 0.1.

h2.protocol: Unit: products with parsed ingredients (ingredients_n > 0), so a missing sweetener flag means 'none detected', not 'unknown'. Strata: level-2 food groups (comparable categories) with >= 30 products in each arm. Sugars: two-sided Mann-Whitney U, effect = median difference (sweetener - none) with bootstrap 95% CI (1000 resamples, seed 43) and rank-biserial r. Bootstrap uses every observation of both arms. Nutri-Score: chi-square sweetener x grade on graded products when all expected counts are >= 5; otherwise grades are merged into AB/C/DE, and the stratum is skipped if that is still too sparse. Cramer's V, Holm correction within each family.
